department: School of Science — Division of Life Science

deadline.value: Fall 2027-28 non-local full-time deadline is June 1, 2027 (rolling admissions; local full-time deadline July 15, 2027; HKPFS deadline December 1, 2026).
deadline.quote: For 2027/28 Fall Term Intake (commencing in Sep 2027): | Non-local Applicants* | Full-time: 1 Jun 2027 | Local Applicants | Full-time: 15 Jul 2027 | Admissions is on rolling basis.

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for life science or molecular medicine (ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Division of Life Science notes straight 4-year PhD enrollment requires support from a thesis supervisor (exceptional cases such as HKPFS awardees; bachelor's/MSc applicants are normally encouraged to enroll in MPhil first), while general pre-application supervisor contact is not required.

funding.value: Full-time PhD students are eligible for HKUST Postgraduate Studentships (HK$229,620/yr, ~US$29,420/yr for up to 4 years), RedBird PhD Award, and HKPFS.
funding.quote: Postgraduate Studentship (PGS) | HK$229,620 per year (~US$29,420/ year) | Up to 4 years for full-time PhD students

entry_route.value: Admits bachelor's and master's holders (2027-28 catalog lists 3-year with research master's and 4-year without; Division page encourages MPhil-first entry unless approved for straight 4-year PhD with supervisor support, e.g., HKPFS).
entry_route.quote: Full-time: 3 years (with a relevant research master’s degree), 4 years (without a relevant research master’s degree) | Applicants seeking admissions to a doctoral degree program should have obtained a bachelor’s degree with a proven record of outstanding performance from a recognized institution

also.quote: Students with Bachelor's or MSc degrees who are aiming for PhD are encouraged to enroll in the MPhil program (2 years) first. | Alternatively, a student may still opt for a straight 4-year PhD program with the support of his/her thesis supervisor. Approval will be granted to exceptional cases such as awardees of the HK PhD Fellowships.

notes: Umbrella life sciences PhD housing Molecular and Cellular Neuroscience / Nervous System Disorders (neuro) and the Molecular Medicine Concentration (biomed), plus a Sussex-HKUST PhD Dual-degree option. Department requires bachelor's GPA/grade average of 3 or above.
